title_en: Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Jurisdiction and Acceptance of Litigation Cases Related to the Regulatory Functions of Stock Exchanges

articles.content_en: In accordance with the relevant provisions of Article 37 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and Article 23 of the Administrative Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the Intermediate People's Courts of the places where the Shanghai Stock Exchange and the Shenzhen Stock Exchange are located shall, respectively, have jurisdiction over first-instance civil and administrative cases related to the regulatory functions of stock exchanges, in which the Shanghai Stock Exchange or the Shenzhen Stock Exchange is the defendant or a third party.

Where an investor brings an action against acts committed by a stock exchange in the course of performing its regulatory duties, which acts concern securities issuers and their relevant personnel, stock exchange members and their relevant personnel, or securities listing and trading activities, and which do not directly involve the interests of investors, the People's Court shall not accept the case.

These Provisions shall come into force as of the date of issuance.
